question: Should these four helpers become supported public Plugin SDK contracts with the defaults and extension points shown in this branch?
rationale: The refactor is structurally sound, but merging commits API shapes and shared authorization/secret behavior across many bundled and third-party plugin surfaces; repository history cannot choose that long-term contract automatically.

options.title: Approve contracts after parity review
options.body: Confirm the four API shapes, rebase, and require exact-head focused and extension-wide validation before landing the shared implementation.

options.title: Narrow the exported surface
options.body: Reduce or reshape the helpers before migration if maintainers do not want all four abstractions to become third-party Plugin SDK commitments.

options.title: Pause the broad consolidation
options.body: Keep channel-local implementations until the shared API and cross-channel security blast radius have a clearer owner-approved boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve contracts after parity review
recommendation.body: Confirm the four API shapes, rebase, and require exact-head focused and extension-wide validation before landing the shared implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to current approval-helper history and authored the canonical issue defining the intended consolidation boundary.
